Barometer Capital Management Inc. Has $20.47 Million Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Alanna Baker | Dec 22nd, 2018
Barometer Capital Management Inc. increased its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 166.1% during the 3rd quarter, according to the company in its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 90,676 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 56,600 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for approximately 1.6% of Barometer Capital Management Inc.’s holdings, making the stock its 16th biggest holding. Barometer Capital Management Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $20,469,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Several other hedge funds and other institutional investors have also recently modified their holdings of AAPL. Delphi Private Advisors LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at $120,000. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $133,000. CX Institutional bought a new stake in shares of Apple during the 2nd quarter valued at $135,000. Gainplan LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple during the 1st quarter valued at $200,000. Finally, Boston Standard Wealth Management LLC bought a new stake in shares of Apple during the 3rd quarter valued at $204,000. 57.08% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. In other news, insider Luca Maestri sold 100,245 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Thursday, October 4th. The shares were sold at an average price of $228.56, for a total transaction of $22,911,997.20. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 91,665 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $20,950,952.40. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available through the SEC website . Also, COO Jeffrey E. Williams sold 61,998 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction dated Wednesday, October 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $232.33, for a total transaction of $14,403,995.34. Following the sale, the chief operating officer now directly owns 124,695 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $28,970,389.35. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 204,845 shares of company stock valued at $47,015,677 in the last ninety days. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock.
A number of analysts have recently commented on the stock. BidaskClub cut shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating in a report on Wednesday, September 12th. Morgan Stanley restated a “buy” rating and set a $247.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 26th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $272.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Wednesday, October 10th. HSBC cut shares of Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $181.37 price target on the stock. in a research note on Sunday, December 9th. Finally, Royal Bank of Canada reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $240.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, September 11th. Three equities research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-three have given a hold rating and twenty-four have given a buy rating to the stock. The company presently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus price target of $221.36.
Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $150.73 on Friday. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $149.63 and a fifty-two week high of $233.47. The company has a quick ratio of 1.09, a current ratio of 1.12 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87. The stock has a market capitalization of $790.80 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.66, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.18 and a beta of 1.20.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last issued its earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion during the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same quarter in the previous year, the firm earned $2.07 EPS. Apple’s revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. Sell-side analysts forecast that Apple Inc. will post 13.23 earnings per share for the current year. Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
